name: @playliquid/git-lineage
description: PlayLiquid GameOS Git lifecycle contract layer (PL-012): typed lineage/fork/overlay contracts over package-system identities — the lineage edge vocabulary, whole-package fork records, narrow overlay operation records, semantic-diff classification and pure lineage validation with R19 provenance/license gate shapes. Pure contracts only: no IO, no git CLI, no filesystem, no network, no diff engine, no merge algorithm (later work orders).
